result.title: Learning Agent States for Latent Action Modeling
result.comment: 27 pages, 12 figures, 20 tables. Project page: https://agent-state-lam.github.io
result.summary: Latent action models (LAMs) learn action-like latents from unlabeled video by coupling frame-pair inference with latent-conditioned prediction, enabling policy and world-model pretraining. However, what the latent must explain depends on the representation space used for action inference and transition prediction. When this space entangles the agent's evolving physical state with visual context, such as background and persistent agent appearance, inferred latents can encode information unrelated to the agent's actions. To address this challenge, we propose Agent-State LAM, which jointly learns a compact agent-state representation and latent actions modeling its transitions. The compact state aggregates dense visual features into a shared space for both action inference and forward prediction. To guide what this state retains, we introduce spatially matched temporal discrimination (SMTD), which trains the state to distinguish its source frame from nearby frames through spatially flexible matching with frozen local visual features. Rather than comparing global frame representations, SMTD scores each frame by emphasizing its strongest local feature matches across spatial locations. This scoring allows background and persistent agent appearance to remain matched across frames despite displacement, making these shared cues less informative for identifying the source frame and encouraging the representation to capture the agent's evolving physical state. Extensive experiments on distracting control tasks and six real robot video datasets demonstrate improved action recovery, downstream control, and world-model prediction. Code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/Mid-Push/Agent-State-LAM.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Agent-State LAM，联合学习紧凑的 agent-state 表示与刻画其转移的 latent action；并引入空间匹配的时间判别目标（SMTD），用冻结局部视觉特征做空间灵活匹配来区分源帧与邻近帧，促使状态保留 agent 演变中的物理状态而非背景与固定外观。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用什么训练目标决定 latent 保留哪些内容」这一设计与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、信息坍缩、任务必要信息是否留存的问题直接对应，可供核查；但论文属机器人视频与动作/世界模型建模，无语言推理环节，迁移需较多改造。
